title: They Thought a Ghost Saved Them in the Trench
topic: WW2/WW1 artillery 'death whisper' — soldiers hear a voice telling them to drop before a shell hits; later linked to low-frequency ground rumble from heavy guns
claim: He heard whispers telling him to lie flat — then a shell killed everyone still standing.
hook: A voice. A drop. Then the blast — and the ghost was physics.
source: Battlefield accounts of artillery acoustic/precursor cues; low-frequency ground-borne rumble from heavy guns discussed in military acoustics / popular science retellings of the 'death whisper' phenomenon (WWI–WWII trench lore).
